sections.label: AI industrial policy critique
sections.summary: The speaker appreciates policy-makers' work and consultation but says Singapore needs a more comprehensive AI industrial policy and clearer industry outcomes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: I appreciate the hard work that many policy-makers have put into writing this report, including their efforts to consult with industry.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: However, I believe that Singapore needs a more comprehensive AI industrial policy and clearer outcomes for each industry.

sections.label: 15,000 AI jobs goal
sections.summary: The NAIS 2.0 goal to generate 15,000 AI jobs sparked both enthusiasm and apprehension among Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The goal in NAIS 2.0 to generate 15,000 AI jobs sparked a blend of enthusiasm and apprehension among Singaporeans.

sections.label: AI jobs for Singaporeans
sections.summary: The speaker asks whether the Government will commit to at least two-thirds of the 15,000 new AI practitioner jobs going to Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Will the Government commit to ensuring that a sizable majority of at least two-thirds of the 15,000 new "AI practitioner" jobs will go to Singaporeans?

sections.label: Moonshots in AI
sections.summary: A moonshot is an ambitious, exploratory and groundbreaking target that can spur breakout growth, and the speaker says NAIS 2.0 appears to lack such moonshots.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: A “moonshot” is an ambitious, exploratory and groundbreaking target that has the possibility of spurring breakout growth.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: We need moonshots in AI, which NAIS 2.0 appears to lack.

sections.label: AI Catalyst Corporation proposal
sections.summary: The speaker says a new government-owned AI startup, which he calls the AI Catalyst Corporation, is needed to catalyse this moonshot.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: A new government-owned AI startup will be needed to catalyse this moonshot and, I will refer to it as the AI Catalyst Corporation.

sections.label: Healthcare data ecosystem for AI
sections.summary: Singapore has a unique opportunity to build a population-scale healthcare data ecosystem for AI, with MOH TRUST and NEHR aggregating research and clinical data.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Singapore, on the other hand, has a unique opportunity to build population-scale healthcare data ecosystem, tailored for AI.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: A platform called MOH TRUST already aggregates multiple healthcare research datasets and the National Electronic Health Records (NEHR) system, aggregates clinical data across Singapore.

sections.label: Exporting specialised services and diagnoses
sections.summary: The aim should be to export specialised services and medical diagnoses rather than raw data, creating an advanced AI model trained on genetics, protein biomarkers, histology and electronic health records.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: We should aim to export specialised services and medical diagnoses, not raw data.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: We can create an advanced AI model trained on genetics, protein biomarkers, histology and electronic health records.

sections.label: NEHR needs AI-ready system
sections.summary: The NEHR system is valuable but needs to be AI-ready to consolidate complex datasets such as histology imaging, genetic data or protein data.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: As for electronic health records, the NEHR system is valuable, but, it needs to be AI-ready in order to consolidate complex datasets such as histology imaging, genetic data or protein data.

sections.label: AI Healthcare Company under AI Catalyst
sections.summary: An AI Healthcare Company under the AI Catalyst Corporation could drive this moonshot, needing its own versatile multi-modal foundation model integrated with the NEHR.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: An AI Healthcare Company under the AI Catalyst Corporation could drive this moonshot.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: This AI healthcare company needs its own versatile multi-modal foundation model, integrated with the NEHR.

sections.label: Building best healthcare AI dataset
sections.summary: The AI healthcare company could build the world's best multi-modal healthcare AI and healthcare dataset.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The AI healthcare company could build the world's best multi-modal healthcare AI and healthcare dataset.

sections.label: Frontier position and national approach
sections.summary: The first company to create a versatile multi-modal healthcare foundation model would likely be at the frontier of healthcare AI, in a national approach to secure data sovereignty, navigate privacy concerns, ensure Singapore captures AI benefits and maximise public buy-in.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Just like how OpenAI's access to ChatGPT queries, provides unmatched data for improving their future large language models, the first company to create a versatile multi-modal healthcare foundation model would likely find itself at the frontier of healthcare AI.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: It is a national approach, designed to secure data sovereignty, navigate data privacy concerns, ensure Singapore captures the benefits of AI and maximise public buy-in.

sections.label: Government view on outcomes
sections.summary: The Government has a different view of how to achieve the outcomes, but the outcomes are agreed, and traditional industrial policy approaches are not effective for frontier digital technologies like AI.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: I think the Government also has a different view of how we should achieve the outcomes, but I would reiterate, we agree that the outcomes are the same.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: So, on the outcomes, traditional industrial policy approaches, where governments pick winners and centrally plan the way to success, are not going to be effective for frontier digital technologies like AI.

sections.label: Singapore AI ecosystem growth
sections.summary: Singapore advances its interest by growing its AI ecosystem, partnering internationally and creating jobs, with National AI 2.0 details to come at COS.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: We advance Singapore's interest by growing our AI ecosystem, partnering internationally, creating good jobs, benefiting our companies and our citizens.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: We will be sharing more details on the implementation of the recently launched National Artificial Intelligence 2.0 at the Committee of Supply (COS) debates.

sections.label: AI in Health funding
sections.summary: Since 2019, $35 million has been dedicated through the AI in Health Grand Challenge for projects using AI in risk prediction, treatment and health coaching.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: For healthcare, we have dedicated $35 million through the AI in Health Grand Challenge since 2019 to support innovative projects that use AI to predict risk, tailor treatments and enhance health coaching.

sections.label: Sectoral AI Centres of Excellence
sections.summary: A new sectoral Centres of Excellence model partners industry champions, and the AI Trailblazers Initiative with Google Cloud helps enterprises build generative AI use cases in a hundred days.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: We have a new model of sectoral Centres of Excellence, partnering industry champions to identify sectoral use cases, developing a broader base of researchers and companies to intensify sophisticated AI development and deployment here.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: We are also working to speed up value discovery, experimentation and innovation, including the AI Trailblazers Initiative, working with Google Cloud to help enterprises bring novel generative AI use cases to life in a hundred days.

sections.label: AI training programmes
sections.summary: The Tech Skills Accelerator and AI apprenticeship programmes have trained many Singaporeans for AI related roles, with more plans to be elaborated at COS.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: For example, the Tech Skills Accelerator and AI apprenticeship programmes have trained many Singaporeans to take on AI related roles and we will elaborate on additional plans at the COS.

sections.label: Access to global data
sections.summary: Singapore must maintain access to and use of global data and models, and resist data localisation narratives.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: We must maintain our ability to access and use global data and models to deliver good outcomes for Singapore and Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: It is important to resist the allure of data localisation narratives.

sections.label: Cost of generative AI models
sections.summary: The speaker notes companies must invest tens-of-billions of US dollars for one generative AI model, responding to a proposal to rely only on own data.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: He proposes, I believe, that we rely on our own data only and develop an AI model at scale ourselves.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: I would point out that companies have to invest tens-of-billions of dollars – billions with a "b" – of US dollars for one generative AI model.

sections.label: Protectionism harm and sitting time
sections.summary: Protectionism is said to harm and undermine credibility, and the next Sitting will start at 11.00 am.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Taking a protectionist stance will do us more harm than good and it will undermine our hard-won credibility as a serious, constructive, inclusive society and nation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Pursuant to Standing Order 2(3)(a), I wish to inform hon Members that the Sitting tomorrow will commence at 11.00 am.
